key_findings: Oral MaR1 given days 3-5 after SNI reduced mechanical hypersensitivity in both sexes for days beyond treatment and reduced spinal Iba-1 and GFAP.
MaR1 did not change spinal IL-1β, IL-6 or IL-10; M-CSF marginally rose in males.
